parameters.name: GroupNameLike
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy query is supported.

parameters.name: GroupNames
parameters.description: The names of the protected object groups that you want to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the current WAF instance ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**, which indicates 20 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
